video_caption: The video opens at 0:05 with a bright blue sky filled with scattered white, wispy clouds and two distinct, long white contrails. White text appears on the screen, asking "Why do antidepressants take so long to work?". The scene then transitions at 0:15 to an indoor setting, focusing on a person in a white lab coat with a green stethoscope around their neck. This person is shown from the chest down, holding a pen and writing on a white document on a clipboard. In the blurred background, another person, presumably a patient, is seated, wearing a brown and black striped sweater, with their hands clasped in front of them. The shot maintains this view until 0:22.

The video opens with an upward shot of a modern skyscraper featuring a grid of reflective glass windows, mirroring the cloudy, overcast sky. This transitions into a low-angle, first-person perspective from inside a moving vehicle, showing the dashboard in the foreground as it travels through a dark tunnel illuminated by distant, blurred yellow and blue lights. The final part of the segment shows a close-up of a scattering of colorful pharmaceutical pills and white tablets on a grey, reflective surface.

The video begins with a person seen from behind, wearing a light-colored hoodie, their brown hair slightly disheveled by the wind. They are standing on a rocky shoreline, looking out at a dramatic natural landscape featuring a tall waterfall cascading down a steep, lush green mountain face into a dark body of water. On the right side of the frame, several dark-colored seals or sea lions are resting on the rocks near the water. The scene then transitions to a different person, also viewed from behind, wearing a dark t-shirt. This person is standing on a hill or overlook, observing a sprawling landscape during either sunrise or sunset, with the sky displaying warm orange and yellow tones. In the mid-ground, a body of water and scattered buildings are visible in a valley, while a distant city skyline is faintly silhouetted against the horizon.

The video opens with a shot of a person from behind, their head and shoulders silhouetted against a vibrant sunset. They are standing on a hill overlooking a large body of water, possibly a reservoir, with a distant city skyline visible on the right horizon. The sky is a warm gradient of orange, pink, and light blue as the sun sets. The scene then transitions to a black screen displaying nine words in white text, arranged in three rows: "love sadness truth", "pain hug rejection", "comfort hate smile". As the narration describes depression, the words "sadness", "pain", "rejection", and "hate" become slightly brighter, indicating a focus on negative stimuli. Specifically, "sadness" and "hate" are highlighted even more prominently. The video then transitions to a grid of six black and white oval portraits. Initially blurred, they gradually sharpen to reveal various faces: a smiling young girl, an older man with a wide, almost theatrical grimace, another older man with a gentle smile, a second smiling young girl, a stern-looking older man with a beard, and a third smiling young girl in a hat. As the narration continues, the portraits of the grimacing older man (top middle) and the stern older man (bottom middle) become brighter and more distinct, while the four smiling faces around them fade slightly, illustrating the tendency to fixate on negative facial expressions.

The video begins with a white screen displaying the black text "Negative affective bias" (English: "Negative affective bias"). Below the text is a black and white circular portrait of an older man with a gaunt face and a somber, serious expression, which remains on screen as a narrator defines the terms "negative," "affective," and "bias" in relation to the title. The scene then transitions from the static text and portrait to a blurred, colorful image that quickly resolves into a clear view of Pierre-Auguste Renoir's painting "Luncheon of the Boating Party." The painting depicts a vibrant outdoor gathering of approximately fourteen people, primarily young men and women, on a terrace by a body of water. They are engaged in conversation, drinking wine, and enjoying food at a table laden with bottles and glasses. Many figures wear straw hats and light clothing, and a small dog is visible in the foreground with one of the women. The overall atmosphere appears joyful and social. The narrator initially highlights the bright colors, the friends enjoying each other's company, and a girl playing with her dog. However, the scene then focuses on a specific girl in the middle-left of the painting, wearing a striped dress and hat, who is quietly sipping from a glass, holding her hand to her chin. The rest of the painting blurs, and her face is isolated and slightly magnified, while the narrator suggests that her expression betrays a "sense of loneliness," contrasting with the jovial mood of the other party-goers, to illustrate the concept of negative affective bias. The video concludes with an audible buzzing sound as the girl's face remains highlighted.

The video segment opens with a blurry painting, likely Renoir's "Luncheon of the Boating Party," in the background, with a smaller, clearer inset image of a woman from the painting who is smiling and holding a glass. This transitions to a shot from behind of a woman with braided hair and sunglasses on her head, wearing a red top, standing on a beach and gazing at large waves crashing on the shore. The scene then shifts to a view through a rain-streaked window, showing blurry green trees and distant orange lights reflecting on a wet surface outside. The final two scenes depict melting frozen treats: first, a mint green ice cream cone with chocolate that has fallen on its side and is melting into a puddle on a white surface, and then two popsicles, one chocolate (covered in ice crystals) and one yellow, also melting into frothy puddles on a white background.

The video opens with a blurred shot of various colorful pills scattered on a white surface, including red and yellow capsules, white oval pills, and a blue and turquoise capsule, which then comes into focus. The pills become blurred again as white text appears centrally, stating: "Antidepressants work by decreasing negative affective biases". This text remains on screen as the pills continue to be out of focus. Following this, a close-up shot shows a person's hand holding a digital stopwatch in a dark setting, displaying various times rapidly, such as "00:07:56". Around the stopwatch, several white words appear and disappear, including "love", "sadness", "truth", "pain", "hug", "rejection", "comfort", "hate", and "smile". A blurred image of a painting then appears to the right of the stopwatch, which quickly sharpens to reveal a child with a drink. The scene transitions to a blurred close-up of an older man's face wearing a red and white patterned head covering, which then sharpens to show him smiling subtly. Finally, the video displays two melting popsicles on a white surface—one chocolate-colored and one yellow—followed by a shot of a mint-green ice cream scoop, topped with chocolate sauce, that has fallen from a waffle cone and melted onto the white surface.

The video opens with a close-up shot of a melting scoop of mint chocolate chip ice cream, drizzled with chocolate sauce, oozing from a waffle cone onto a clean white surface. This transitions to a macro shot of a watch face, highlighting the intricate texture of the dial, the minute hand pointing towards 10, and the sweep of the second hand. Next, a person wearing blue pants and striped grey and white socks is seen putting on a white canvas sneaker (possibly Converse), pulling the tongue and adjusting the shoe on a brown, textured carpet. The shot then focuses on their hands as they carefully tie the white laces of the sneaker, securing a bow. Finally, the scene shifts to an upward view of vibrant green tree canopies, with bright sunlight dappling through the leaves, suggesting a natural outdoor setting.

The video opens with an overhead view of lush green trees and foliage, with bright sunlight dappling through the leaves and creating a blurry, lens-flare effect (00:00-00:04). This natural scene is then distorted by what appears to be raindrops or water droplets on the lens, making the green foliage appear more diffused (00:04-00:10). The scene transitions to an indoor shot of two people sitting on a light brown sofa, likely in a therapy session (00:10-00:37). The person on the right, wearing a white top and light beige pants, holds a blue clipboard and a gold pen, actively writing on a paper. Their fingernails are painted white. Facing them, with their back to the camera, is another person wearing a white shirt. A light-colored pillow is visible on the sofa between them. At 00:14, the text "Cognitive behavioral therapy" appears on the left side of the screen, providing context for the interaction, and it remains visible until 00:23 before fading out. The person in the white shirt occasionally gestures with their right hand as if speaking, while the therapist continues to write. The video concludes with a close-up of an abstract, organic pattern in shades of yellow, brown, and black, resembling cells or microscopic organisms, moving slightly (00:37-00:39).

The video begins with the text "Brain derived neurotrophic factor" displayed in white letters against a blurry, abstract yellow-brown background that resembles microscopic cells or particles. At 00:08, this transitions to a stylized, semi-transparent 3D model of a human brain viewed from the side, predominantly in shades of blue and green. A central area within the brain, appearing as an almond-shaped structure and a smaller, connected, teardrop-shaped structure, is highlighted in bright yellow-orange. At 00:15, an abstract visual shows a red and orange blob-like shape (resembling the previously highlighted brain section) surrounded by a dark, watery blue background, with numerous small white particles appearing to stream away from it. This then transitions back to the brain model at 00:19, which is now dark blue-green and covered with many small, sparkling white dots, suggesting neural activity or connections, particularly concentrated in the central region and extending to other parts. As the segment progresses, different areas of the brain model light up in shifting colors from pink to bright green and yellow, indicating activity spreading across various regions.

The video opens with a gloved hand adjusting a microscope, focusing on a slide with a visible sample. This transitions to a close-up of a clear liquid dripping from a medical tube into a small glass vial, with the text "Ketamine" appearing on screen. The scene then shifts to a close-up of a red digital clock, its LED numbers rapidly counting from 0:57, resetting, and then counting up to 1:38. Following this, an outdoor shot shows a digital speed limit sign on a pole beside a tree-lined road with cars passing by; the sign initially displays "38", then "88", goes blank, and then shows "28". A beautiful time-lapse sequence of a sunset over a field with moving clouds follows, painting the sky in hues of orange and red. The video then moves indoors to a low-angle shot of a ceiling fan spinning in a dimly lit, crowded bookstore, revealing shelves packed tightly with books and several indistinct figures browsing. As red liquid swirls and diffuses in a clear medium, the text "Some antidepressants do not involve serotonin" appears on screen. This is followed by another time-lapse, this time of sunlight breaking through dark, moving clouds, with bright rays visible. The segment concludes with a silhouette shot of two people on a beach, watching a vivid orange sunset over the ocean, with a bottle between them. The text "Depressive realism" is superimposed over this blurred, evocative scene.

The video segment opens with a close-up, slightly blurry shot of various medication pills and capsules on a reflective, dark grey surface. There are blue and teal capsules, red and white capsules, a white round pill, and a yellow capsule, suggesting a collection of different medicines. The camera slowly pans across these objects, highlighting their different shapes and colors as they reflect on the surface.

The video segment features a static graphic on a red background. Concentric, thin, light red circles radiate from the upper right portion of the screen. In the upper right corner, there is an icon of a lightbulb with a yellow brain illustrated inside it, surrounded by a dotted yellow halo, symbolizing an idea or intelligence. Below the lightbulb, a dark blue rectangular box contains the white capitalized text, "MEMORABLE PSYCHIATRY."
